label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: support@clockpoint.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
Subject: Re: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts

Dear Faith,

Thank you for picking this up. Here are the details you asked for.

1. Terminal model and firmware: four BX-300 terminals at our Embakasi depot, now on firmware 4.2.1. They auto-updated from 4.1.8 on the night of 27 October. Our two BX-300s at Mombasa Road were offline that week, so they are still on 4.1.8 and are not affected.

2. Shift template: NIGHT-8, 22:00 to 06:00.

3. Example: staff ID T-0417 clocked in at 21:54 on 30 October and out at 06:07 on 31 October. The export showed 2.1 hrs REG on 30 October and 6.1 hrs OT15 on 31 October. We expected 8.0 hrs REG plus 0.2 hrs OT15. We round to the nearest tenth of an hour, so the 8 h 13 min total is 8.2 hrs, and only the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift should be OT15.

4. Export profile: Payroll CSV v2.

5. First noticed: 5 November, while reviewing the draft October overtime. The affected records start from about 28 October, the day after the firmware update.

In short, every shift that crosses midnight is being split into two lines, and the after-midnight line is coded OT15 instead of REG. This affects all 38 staff on nights at Embakasi. The day shift at Mombasa Road is fine. Your release notes for 4.2.1 promised improved midnight rollover handling for shifts spanning two calendar days, and we have had the exact opposite.

Two things I need from you:

First, a plain answer on rollback. Brian Ochieng in our IT team manages the terminals and can roll the four Embakasi units back to 4.1.8. Is that safe to do, and will we lose any punch data if he does? He will not touch them until we hear from you.

Second, timing. Our November payroll inputs close on Friday 20 November. We corrected October by hand from the raw punches and cannot keep doing that, so we need a fix or a clear workaround before the 20th.

I have copied Kevin Mutua, our payroll officer. He found the issue and will test whatever you suggest, so kindly keep him in the thread.

Kind regards,
Njeri Mwangi
HR Manager, Tausi Freight
